'''Orazio''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith pureblood]] who held the title of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] and lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Residing on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], Orazio also provided the knowledge of [[Synthweave|synthweaving]] to others.
